messages:
maria: Quick pass on API Keys UI — found a few pragmatic UX/a11y nits around the create/rotate/revoke flows and the empty state. Posting the shortlist.
will: thanks, can you bullet them so eng can pick them up?
maria: sure: (1) empty state lacks example scopes + code snippet; CTA is low contrast; (2) create modal scope pills overflow on mobile; (3) revoke is single-click with no keyboard confirm; (4) rotate toast doesn't say the old key was disabled and lacks undo.
aj: for rotate toast: make it explicit: 'Key rotated — old key invalidated. Undo (30s)'. Also add a modal option to reveal & copy the new key before closing.
liz: empty state fix: swap copy -> snippet -> CTA, surface 'Preset: minimal' under CTA and show editable chips. Add small badges: 'safe for client' vs 'server only'.
sam: revoke: propose inline 'Type REVOKE' for non-owners, checkbox for owners. Keeps friction but not painful.
will: accessibility: kebab menus lost keyboard handlers in our dropdown. I'll add role=menu and ensure Enter/Space activate items. Also fix focus order so modals focus primary action. Filing ticket.
will: ticket https://issues.internal/RED-8601 (kebab a11y + focus)
design-bot: checklist: modal h2 semantics, initial focus on primary, aria-labels for icon buttons, helper text >=4.5:1 contrast, code snippet uses pre semantics.
maria: small mobile layout: truncate key preview to last 8 chars with copy icon, and right-align action menu to avoid overlap.
will: i'll own kebab + layout CSS this sprint. aj do rotate copy?
aj: yes, will post copy options to the ticket.
liz: i'll update Figma with presets + badges and share link.
maria: acceptance criteria: presets + snippet in empty state, pill truncation + tooltip, revoke confirm flow, rotate toast + undo, kebab/menu keyboard a11y, column rename 'Last used (api)', mobile key preview truncation.
will: noted and added to the epic. thanks everyone :rocket:
